title: Let the urgent signature be placed on the package
goal: Use @keyframes to control displacement and transparency simultaneously, and retain the last frame after playback ends.
summary: emergency label should slide into the dotted box from above the package. The preview will pause at the starting point and you can click "Play" to view or replay.
tasks: defines a set of keyframes. The starting point is 18px above the original position and the opacity is 0.3. The end point is back to the original position and the opacity is 1.
causes .dispatch-stamp to play once using this set of keyframes, taking 400ms, and keeping the ending style.
Keep the existing suspension rules, click "Play" to confirm that the urgent sign falls into the dotted box and stops.

example.note: The file upload prompt fades in from transparent to visible. forwards will keep the hint on the last frame after the animation ends.

hint: If the label returns to its original state after the animation ends, check animation-fill-mode. forwards preserves the displacement and transparency of the last frame.
